fire:
The festival is held every summer in the old town and draws
visitors from far beyond the borders of the country.

On the morning of the ceremony the bells rang across the city and
the crowds gathered early along the river.

The committee argued that the reform would harm small farmers and
leave rural schools without enough teachers.

Her letters describe a long winter in the mountains, when the
roads were closed for weeks at a time.

The author believes that a novel should reflect the world as it
is, not as we would like it to be.

Most of the early settlers came from the coast and brought with
them the customs of their fishing villages.

In the second chapter the narrator returns to his childhood home
and finds that nothing has changed.

The bridge was finished in the spring of that year and quickly
became a symbol of the growing town.
